text:
Noah: Heads up 1: noticed a strange p99 wobble on /v1/generate in us-central after the quota-tuning change. p50/p95 steady, p99 jumps intermittently. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/latency-us-central
Esha: saw the spike. curious if this is a telemetry merge artifact or real tail behavior
Tom: glance at the router logs shows a few hundred requests rerouted to low-cost variants during quota backoff window around 03:10 UTC
Lina: low-cost variants (variant-c-quant) have fine medians but a long decode tail when KV-cache miss occurs or for long prompts
Noah: paste from router around 03:10:
```
[03:10:02] quota_backoff start user=acct42 route=us-central fallback=variant-c-quant
[03:10:03] model_select req=xy12 model=variant-c-quant seq_len=734
[03:10:04] kvcache_miss req=xy12 prefix=conv_
```
Esha: interesting: our p99 rollup uses tdigest snapshots from shards with very different sample volumes; if a shard with 20 samples spikes, the rolled p99 is noisy
Tom: pulled counts: p99 for that 10m window computed from ~210 samples; p95 computed from ~8.6k -> p99 low-n-caveat applies
Lina: but traces show real increased decode tail for requests hitting variant-c-quant with seq_len>600. so both noise + real tail effect
Noah: we should avoid action purely from p99 unless provenance shows sufficient samples. proposal: add a "confidence" band on p99 and show sample_count next to each percentile
Esha: UX idea: a small chevron next to p99 that expands to show per-variant percentiles and sample counts for that endpoint/time range
Tom: ops actions I recommend now:
- temporarily relax aggressive backoff (Noah) so route fallback rate drops
- annotate dashboard with quota-change event (Esha)
- run KV-priming sweep against a small canary to measure warmed tail (Lina)
Noah: agree. also suggest adding route-level column "quota-fallback-rate" in the route table so owners can correlate immediately
Lina: long-term: compute percentile confidence intervals from sample counts and show a faint band on charts. also expose per-model percentile breakdowns in endpoint pane
Esha: small backend ask: when we merge tdigest shards, include per-shard sample counts in metadata so front-end can mark low-confidence p99s
Tom: quick mitigation: rollback the most aggressive quota change from 03:05 UTC -> deployed by rollback request now (Noah)
deploy-bot: Received rollback request from Noah. Rolling quota config on route us-central to previous settings.
Noah: monitoring. if p99 doesn't settle in 12 minutes we'll capture a longer trace set and run a controlled traffic test to isolate cache warmup vs model tail
Lina: I'll start a KV priming job on canary and post the results in 20m
Esha: I'll mock the small chevron UI and the sample-count hover with wording "low samples -> percentile may be unstable" and open a PR
Tom: note for product: routing/quotas that push traffic to cheaper variants need guidance about tail impact; add to routing playbook
Noah: thanks team. follow-up postmortem should include: quota tweak timeline, per-variant percentile splits, tdigest-merge provenance, and proposed UI confidence indicators
Esha: ACK
Lina: ACK :thumbsup:
Tom: ACK
Noah: closing watch window in 15m, will post incident summary to #incidents when done
